name: AgentBox CLI (agentbox)
description: Installs the agentbox CLI. It sets up the installed agent harnesses when the container is created and, on every start, brings the AgentBox tools that follow the latest release and the TALXIS/skills plugin in the harnesses up to date.
postStartCommand: timeout 120 agentbox prerequisite update || true; timeout 120 agentbox harness update || true
